target.statement: Diversity sampling achieves MAE 0.813 ± 0.035 eV/atom on the Ti–O system, a 10.9% improvement over random baseline (0.912 ± 0.041), p = 0.008
target.dataset: Ti–O structures from Materials Project (480) + OQMD (29), 509 total, 407/102 pool/test split

compute.basis: Tiny MLP ensemble (17-dim input, 2x128 hidden) on ~500 samples, 5 seeds x 4 strategies x 6 AL iterations is trivially CPU-cheap; the real cost is re-deriving the exact dataset (MP API key required, OQMD qmpy client, undocumented filtering/dedup) and re-implementing the whole pipeline from scratch since no code is linked.

blockers: No code link despite claiming open-source GitHub availability
Materials Project API requires a registered API key (not freely anonymous)
Exact dataset construction (filters, dedup threshold, feature definitions) underspecified, so exact numbers unlikely to match
OQMD retrieval via qmpy client and DFT-protocol matching not fully specified
title: Active Learning Strategies for Efficient Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials Across Diverse Material Systems
